topic.description: The topic of the notepad, for example "Shard Invocations".

notepad.description: The notepad, for example "(Notepad) 107 Shard Invocations". Set it after Stage 1.

steps.title: Create Notepad
steps.next: Create the notepad on {{topic}}. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} notepad="(Notepad) NNN Title".

steps.title: Gather Context
steps.next: Find the context of {{topic}} in the Flint and in the codebases that it names.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.next: Answer each turn under the next # N of {{output.notepad}} with wkfl-ntpd-continue. When a turn asks for work, invoke the task as a child. When the person ends the conversation, mark this step done.

steps.title: Finish Notepad
steps.next: Run wkfl-ntpd-finish on {{output.notepad}}: extract the artifacts, write the Session Output, and archive the notepad.

behaviours.say: The notepad on {{topic}} is still open (invocation {{invocation}}). To finish it, run wkfl-ntpd-finish before the close. A later session can continue it with wkfl-ntpd-continue.
